config.prompt: Create or refine the UI in target mockups, node ${{review-request.payload.node_id}}. Brief: ${{review-request.payload.brief}} Use figma_query inspect before each small figma_execute edit, include expected_revision, and use stable unique request IDs. On a stale revision, inspect and revise your edit. If an operation is uncertain, stop and report its operation_id; do not retry with a new ID. Stay within your granted design area.

Review immutable Figma snapshot ${{review-snapshot.result.snapshot_id}}. Use figma_execute import_snapshot for target mockups and this snapshot ID, then communication_copy_artifact_to_workspace for each artifact_id. Inspect preview.png and design.json. Give actionable feedback with the snapshot ID and node IDs. Add a Figma comment if useful. Your task is review.
